title: Seaside "Sister 1" 125 Quincy Circle Unit A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private covered balcony with Gulf views- Short walk to the beach, community pools, and amenities- Steps from the famous Seaside Town Square featuring plenty of shopping and dining- Parking for 1 vehicle - Wifi- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: The "Sister 1" in Seaside's Ruskin Place is a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo that sleeps 6 and provides stunning views of Seaside's art district, downtown Seaside, and the Gulf. Take in spectacular views from the balcony, and relax in a modern interior. Enjoy a vacation that is mere steps from Seaside's famous amphitheater, community pools, boutiques, restaurants, and private beach access. "Sister 1" is located above a Ruskin Place business, providing bird's eye views of this famous New Urbanist community from every room. An open-concept kitchen, dining, and living room with warm copper accents and rich wood details welcome guests. Premium stainless steel appliances and a curved kitchen island with seating for 2 surround cabinetry and shelves crafted from the same beautiful Maple as the wall. A glass-top dining table with seating for 6 blends seamlessly into the comfortable living room. A slip-covered sleeper sofa and loveseat face a flat-screen TV and enjoy natural light from double doors that open onto a large balcony. You might catch a bit of a New Orleans vibe outside on the balcony. Cushioned chairs are ideal for sitting and watching people stroll through the oak-covered park in Ruskin Place to Seaside's bustling shopping area. Off the kitchen is a guest bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower. A primary bedroom off the living room has a king bed with floor-to-ceiling windows and a private bathroom with a shower.A balcony with a outdoor sofa and chairs offers phenomenal views of the Gulf, downtown Seaside, and the roofscapes of famous cottages and homes throughout this beloved 30A community. It's a fantastic spot to toast the sunset or share a romantic dance underneath the stars. Don't wait to book Sisters 1. With views and access to all Seaside has to offer, the Sisters 1 will not last long. Book an unforgettable Seaside vacation today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 6):FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub Combo- Queen Sleeper Sofa**The fireplace is for decorative purposes only.**Unfortunately, the HOA in this community prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals or guests from bringing their own.** Please note this unit is on the 2nd floor and does not have elevator access.
